Name: LunaStonePedals
Description:
I DREAM OF AND LIVE FOR GREAT GUITAR TONE
My name is Steen, I live in Copenhagen, Denmark, and I am the founder of LunaStone. First of all, I am a passionate guitarist, but I am also an engineer and something of a dreamer who constantly pursues divine guitar tone.

Decades of gigging and studio sessions taught me an important lesson: Nothing takes my focus off the music like poor sound. And even more importantly, it affects how I play. Eventually, this made me obsessed with the idea of creating the perfect overdrive pedal.

I want loads of transparency and sustain when I kick in a drive pedal. I want to hear my beloved amp and the nuances of my guitar, even at various pickup settings, through the drive. From subtle crunch to high gain, I want to be able to hear me. Because that is when I play my absolute best

Therefore, I decided to start from scratch. I isolated every single component, played, listened, tuned and tweaked until I knew exactly how different transistors like JFETs, MOSFETs, BJTs, and a handful of classic op-amps and diodes, amplified and colored my guitar tone. Based on these intensive experiments and thorough listening sessions, I came up with a brand new design that I call TrueOverDriveTM.

The most fundamental finding I made was that diode-clipping is not the answer when your goal is to create the ultimate overdrive tone. Interestingly, though, the vast majority of drive pedals are based on diode-clipping, so this is truly a major leap away from traditional designs.

In essence, My TrueOverDrive approach is based strictly on cascaded gain stages all the way from input to output. This way, it sounds and feels like a real tube amp overdriving the signal. The dynamics are similar to what you get from cranked tubes, and I can control so many tonal nuances with nothing but my fingers and the volume knob on my guitar. And most important of all, I can keep my sole focus on playing the music that I love.

Name: Thomsen Electronics
Description:
Thomsen Electronics develops customized electronics and firmware for industrial machinery and devices. The developer has 20+ years of experience with development of industrial electronics.

Many industrial machines are controlled by PLCs. This is a relatively quick and versatile way to manufacture industrial machinery, but can also be quite costly. If your company makes many similar or identical machines, you might consider switching from PLCs to customized electronics. Thomsen Electronics can help you with that.

The cost of a PCB will typically be a tiny fraction of the cost of a PLC, with the same inputs and outputs. The PCB can be designed so sensors and actuators can be connected directly to dedicated connectors, thus reducing or eliminating the need for rows of terminal blocks. All I/O ports, analog and digital, are on the same PCB, instead of being divided into separate modules. Furthermore, special input and output ports, not typically found in PLCs, can be added to a customized PCB.

As a Thomsen Electronics customer, you will be part of the development process, including the choice of connectors and terminals. When the customized control PCB has been designed correctly, machine wiring should be noticeably faster and easier, further reducing cost.

Also, customer specific features can be added to the controller firmware, adding functionality that you may not have had in your PLC.

Apart from the usual industrial analog and digital inputs and outputs, the PCB can be equipped with ports for
- Photodiodes and other optical sensors
- Pressure sensors
- Oxygen sensors
- Thermo-electric coolers (TEC)
- AC current transformers
- Flame sensors
- Load cells
and the list goes on.

Please let me hear about your needs for an industrial control unit, so I can help you reduce cost and add functionality to your industrial product.

Custom Piezo Components: Tailored for both prototyping and high-volume production.

Hard & Soft PZT: Optimized for high-power sonar and sensitive sensor applications.

The initial draft of the idea came during the Innovation Week project carried by VIA University College and the Kaospilots. The ideas were to be reviewed by Mejlgade Lab project manager, Jonatan Marcussen.

As the winning team, we decided to continue developing our concept with help and guidance offered by both Mejlgade Lab and VIA University. The project is now shaping under the name Bio Lights.

The Idea
Bio Lights came up with a light-pole concept that is completely green, can be placed anywhere, and uses one of the oldest ways to produce energy-a water mill. It is designed to work only with the help of the end user, therefore giving them the satisfaction of helping make their city cleaner and greener.

Our aim is to show how wasted energy around us can be harvested in an effective and easy way, and to help cities make a change towards using clean energy.

Vandvagt - Passer godt på dine ting og økonomi.

Du kan sikre dig mod vandskader og store vandregninger.

Vandvagt kan overvåge dit vandforbrug og forhindre spild og store vandskader. 
Vandvagten er en elektronisk stophane, som lukker for vandet ved alt overflødigt vandforbrug, så du ikke kommer hjem til en vandskade. 

Vandvagten passer godt på dine ting, hver dag, døgnet rundt og derfor behøver du ikke længere at bekymre dig om vandskader på dit hus og inventar.

Vandvagts reference liste er stor (Industri, landbruget, offentlige bygninger: skoler, rådhuse, samt privat osv.).

Idéen er simpel; når du har et rør der sprænger, så stopper Vandvagten for vandet.
Du kan sammenligne en Vandvagt med selen i din bil, der sikrer dig, når du har mest brug for det. 
I dag har vi mere end et dusin produkter, der kan hjælpe dig med at spare penge og bekymringer over uventede vandskader. 
Vores produkter giver dig sikkerhed, kontrol over dit vandforbrug og ikke mindst: du kan spare penge på dine forsikringer. (Anbefalet af forsikrings-branchen).

Vores missioner er blandt andet at beskytte flest mulige bygninger i Danmark, så vandskader bliver historie, samt at forbedre miljøet ved at begrænse unødigt vandspild. 

Vandvagt er en dansk opfindelse og stadig i dag er produktionen i Danmark, fordi det er vigtigt for os at levere kvalitetsprodukter til vores kunder.

Name: Knud Jørgensen El
Description:
Hvem er Knud Jørgensen El ApS? 
El-installatør Knud Jørgensen er grundlæggeren af Knud Jørgensen ApS. Knud startede som selvstændig el-installatør tilbage i midten af 80'erne, og d. 26. juni 1992 blev selskabet stiftet, dog først under navnet Esbjerg El & Hvidevareservice APS, hvilket stammede fra en installatør virksomhed i Esbjerg, som Knud købte af sin tidligere mester.

Senere blev selskabet omdøbt til Knud Jørgensen ApS. Knud drev her igennem el-installatør virksomhed i mange år sideløbende med hvidevaresalg og service gennem navnet Den Grønne Butik.

Ejerkredsen udvides   
I 2009 blev selskabet delt op i to da ejerkredsen blev udvidet med Bent Kristensen på el-installatør delen, den del kom til at hedde Knud Jørgensen El ApS, Knud fortsatte under navnet Knud Jørgensen ApS og butiksdelen under navnet Den Grønne Butik.

I 2010 blev el-installatør delen igen udvidet og Henrik Terp Kristensen indtrådte også i ejerkredsen.

Flere binavne, som Donslund El Afdeling, DK alarmsikring, esbjergnethvidevare m.fl. blev oprettet pga. virksomheden blev udvidet med flere forretningsområder og afdelinger. 

Forretningen samles under ét driftselskab
Pga. sygdom valgte Knud Jørgensen i 2014 at sælge sine anparter i Knud Jørgensen ApS. Knud er i dag aktivt medlem af bestyrelsen og følger stadig virksomheden fra sidelinjen.

Ejerforholdene er nu 50/50 mellem Bent Kristensen og Henrik Terp Kristensen, og i forbindelse med seneste køb af Billund El-Service ApS, har man valgt at fusionere i dag er der kun ét driftselskab med afdeling i Esbjerg, Gørding, Billund og Aarhus

Med fusionen er alle afdelinger med viden og kompetence  indenfor energiløsninger nu samlet og kan klare enhver el opgave, både for private, industri, landbrug og erhverv. Hvidevaresalg og service er også stadig et stort forretningsområde for os

Name: Okholm Lighting A/S
Description:

Virksomheden har 50 års erfaring i specialløsninger til alle former for dekorativ belysning, samt kunde specifikke produkter.
Derfor er vores filosofi også: 

Lys der skaber rum
Okholm Lighting skaber lys til store rum. Det kan være domiciler, auditorier, teatre, kirker eller uderum som parker og pladser. Typisk er det arkitekten, der sammen med bygherren har ideerne og visionen om rummets belysning. Hos Okholm Lighting er vi eksperter i at gøre disse ideer og visioner til virkelighed – og til fantastiske rum.

Skræddersyede løsninger
Visioner om rummets belysning kan sjældent realiseres med standardløsninger. 
I stedet for at tage udgangspunkt i et sortiment af produkter, udvikler vi hos Okholm Lighting unikke løsninger skræddersyet til det enkelte projekt.  Alt kan lade sig gøre! Med det udgangspunkt har vi skabt en række enestående designs og belysningsløsninger i Danmark og i udlandet.

Plads til kreativitet
Okholm Lighting er en fleksibel og løsningsorienteret virksomhed, som lægger vægt på effektiv og professionel projektstyring. Vi magter alle aspekter af fremstilling af lys og kan derfor indgå i et nært samarbejde med projektudvikleren i alle byggeriets faser. Vi er engagerede og elsker at afprøve andres ideer med hurtige mock-ups og ultimativt udvikle nye designs.

Mere end funktionalitet
Moderne belysning til store rum tjener mange formål: Belysningen understøtter rummets funktioner ved at skabe den stemning, der naturligt passer til funktionaliteten. Intimitet, højtidelighed eller tryghed er eksempler på sådanne stemninger. Belysning bliver i stadig stigende grad en oplevelse i sig selv, således at lys og skyggevirkninger, farver og armaturer bliver en integreret del af hele rummets udtryk. Her bliver lys til design!

En uafhængig analyse fra Aalborg Recycling dokumenterer et genanvendelsespotentiale på hele 97,64 %.

Nordicco was founded to reduce energy consumption in large buildings.

It’s not just a good idea – it’s a necessity. Buildings consume around 30% of the world’s total energy – mainly for heating, ventilation, and lighting (International Energy Agency). That’s why energy optimization is one of the keys to the green transition.

And we’ve already taken off. Today, our fans are spinning in airports, sports arenas, schools, shopping centers, factories, and logistics hubs across Europe. 

We started out as a traditional manufacturing company. But as we connected our solutions to our own IoT platform, we’ve grown into a modern tech company.

Today, we don’t just distribute heat and air efficiently – we deliver data and insights into a building’s indoor climate and energy use. This gives our customers a data-driven foundation to achieve – and document – their energy savings.

The need for gas detection and the requirements for gas alarms vary greatly from industry to industry. Name: Subra
Description:
Subra is a Danish deep-tech developing revolutionary superconductor solutions for zero-loss power transmission and fusion energy. 

We are driven by one goal: to create lasting impact through technology. A greener, more resilient, and carbon-neutral future is possible.

But real transformation can only happen through collaboration. That is why we work closely with industry leaders, governments, research institutions, and visionary investors to accelerate the energy transition – together.

As the world shifts away from fossil fuels toward electrification and carbon-neutral energy sources, our energy systems are under immense pressure. We need to move more electricity, over longer distances, with greater reliability and minimal loss. At the same time, we must stabilise grids powered by intermittent sources like wind and solar energy, while helping carbon-intensive industries transition to cleaner alternatives.

Our current infrastructure cannot keep up, and that is where superconductors come in. While superconductor technology is complex in nature, the impact is clear: when cooled, superconductors transport electricity with zero resistance - meaning more power can flow with no loss, enabling far greater efficiency than conventional cables. 

But until now, superconductors have been expensive, difficult to scale, and limited by technical constraints.

Subra is changing that. 

Our technologies are based on years of scientific research – designed for sustainable impact. Not only do they have the ability to efficiently transport power across Europe and beyond, they also play a role in tomorrow's energy production. 

Superconductors are, e.g. essential in enabling the strong magnetic fields needed for fusion power reactors. Our innovations can help bring this safe, clean, abundant energy source closer to the grid.

 – Helping build an energy system that is truly sustainable reshaping our energy landscapes across Europe.

Name: Sustain a Print
Description: Printed electronics (PE) is one of the fastest-growing waste streams in the European Union (EU), and less than 40% of electronic waste is estimated to be recycled within the EU. Thus, there is a need to explore new options for electronics that are designed for reuse, repair, and high-quality recycling. PE production is an additive manufacturing method that can address these challenges and is characterized by its versatility, scalability, and low material usage, thus making it an ideal candidate for the circular production of electronics in general. In this context, Sustain-a-Print (SaP) is an EU Horizon project involving 11 stakeholders from 6 countries among universities, research institutes, large enterprises, and SMEs. It uses recycled, bio-based, and biodegradable alternatives to replace fossil-based materials used for PE production. The development of sustainable materials and formulations for PE will follow the principles of the Sustainable and Safe by Design (SSbD) concept focusing on reusing and recycling valuable PE materials. Overall, SaP embraces the EU’s Circular Economy Action Plan to further advance the circularity potential of electronics and electronic equipment prompted by the dire forecasts for increased resource extraction and waste generation and their detrimental effects on climate and biodiversity.

• Industrilakering
• Trykkerimaskiner
• Procesanlæg
• Transportanlæg
• Palleteringsanlæg
• Vandværker
• Rensningsanlæg
• Conveyor anlæg 

In a company, where human resources to a larger extent are replaced with mechanical resources, reliability is a key word – regardless whether it’s about performance of physical activities or data and information handling.

An automation solution can involve everything from simple relay controls to all kinds of PLC and PC controls. With a control or process system, you gain a high level of reliability – and it’s even very user-friendly via a graphic screen, displaying the process as a whole.

 Design, programming, installation and commissioning are performed by our well-educated engineers and automation technicians, with knowledge of most PLC and SCADA systems (Siemens, Rockwell, GE Fanuc, Omron, Modicon – WINCC, IFix). DC Power Supplies
A power supply is often taken for granted as it is seen as an insignificant part of equipment. For most it is just an electronic box ordered at the last moment. However, a power supply can be compared to our heart; It’s often neglected and we tend to pay more attention to our hair. Yet if the heart fails, the system goes down.

Design concept
Delta power supplies have a reputation of being remarkably reliable. Therefore our design concept puts a strong emphasis on long lifetime and excellent technical specifications. The specifications of our products may seem unrealistic at first, but when measured they turn out to be even better as defined. Delta users expect perfection, an almost infinite life time at continuous full power and low cost of ownership. Ongoing research makes it possible to produce products that can meet these ever increasing demands.

Result
As a result of our design philosophy the units react more than 10 times faster on load transients, produce hardly audible noise and produce 10 – 30 times less electromagnetic interference. Delta customers will never face any problems due to radiated or conducted emissions of our power supplies. The same design philosophy applies for immunity: the toughest standard is not good enough for us. A Delta power supply will always operate reliable, even in a very noisy environment.All our power supply units are thoroughly tested before being dispatched to the customer.This ensures long term correct functioning of each unit and client satisfaction. Delta Elektronika produces world class DC power supplies.

PCH Engineering A/S is a Danish, ISO 9001 certified engineering company which develops compact, cost-efficient solutions for industrial vibration monitoring.

What we do
With more than 30 years of experience in the vibration monitoring industry, we offer a wide range of vibration and condition monitoring solutions for rotating machinery such as decanters, pumps, fans, compressors, turbines, centrifuges and more.

Our clients include industrial manufacturers and OEMs worldwide. Among them are also pioneers in the green energy industry with vibration and structural monitoring solutions for rotor sails and wind turbines.


How you can benefit
Our vibration and condition monitoring solutions help safeguard rotating machinery and staff by detecting emerging maintenance issues such as bearing wear, misalignment, cavitation, imbalance etc. at an early stage. 

This enables you to schedule maintenance predictively before the issues cause breakdowns and secondary machine damage. With our solutions, you can extend machine life, optimize the operation of the machinery, and reduce downtime due to maintenance issues.

The monitoring solutions can be factory fitted by OEMs or retro-fitted by manufacturers. They are highly customizable, and our advanced filtering technology ensures that the fault detection matches each machine exactly. 

We work together with industrial partners, certification institutes and universities to provide state-of-the-art solutions performing well, even under extreme conditions.

Name: CIGRE Denmark Next Generation Network (NGN)
Description:
It can be argued that the power industry is one of the most important industries in the world. The need for electrical power is essential for the development of society and the welfare of people; without electric power, the world would still be in the dark-ages. 

For this reason, it is understandable why many people would want to become involved not only within this industry, but also with developing and sharing their technical knowledge to create state-of-the-art and world practices / standards. 

To facilitate this desire of many, CIGRE was established to develop and distribute technical knowledge and experience in the field of the generation and transmission of high voltage electricity. It does this by providing an interactive forum that brings together key players, research workers, producers, manufacturers, system operators, traders, and regulatory bodies. Originally founded in France in 1921, this organisation has expanded worldwide with representatives from more than eighty countries. 

To the non-member (and even to some members), the CIGRE organisation can appear complex and exclusive. To the inexperienced engineer starting out in the power industry, becoming involved with such a prestigious organisation can appear difficult and daunting. 

In order to overcome these barriers that seem to be in place for new engineers, the 'Next Generation Network' (NGN) has been established in order to ensure that everyone's opinions and views are heard, to bring a fresh look to an ever ageing industry and more importantly, so inexperienced engineers can learn from the many experts within the industry. 

That is, the NGN (with members who will no doubt form part of the future CIGRE organisation) will provide the next generation of engineers to lead and to be at the forefront of the power industry in the 21st century and beyond.

Name: PlastiSens ApS
Description:
PlastiSens ApS was founded in 2014 as a spin out from the Department of Micro- and Nanotechnology, Technical University of Denmark. PlastiSens is developing and providing novel sensor systems for detection of antibiotics in milk. The company is owned by the founding team together with Capnova A/S as seed investor.

Currently, on-line detection for antibiotics typically takes place at the dairy factory after the milk from a number of individual farmers has been collected in a common tank truck. Tests taken at the dairy factory are therefore tests pertaining to the entire milk tank and depending on test method may take from 10 minutes and up to 3 hours to perform by specialized laboratory technicians. If antibiotics are detected, then the entire tank of milk must be disposed of, so as not to reach consumers or interfere with dairy processes. As a consequence, there is an estimated yearly loss of € 2 million in Denmark and € >50 million in Europe. 

PlastiSens offers a novel hand-held sensor technology that traces a wide range of antibiotic residues in milk. The sensor is designed to allow for on-site testing by the user without the need for any prior training, all within a time scope of two minutes. After use, the display will inform the user whether or not the level of antibiotics exceeds the MRL, a threshold for antibiotics sanctioned by the European Union. This will allow to make decisions on-site and, most importantly, before contamination of clean milk already in the transport tank.

Fiberlight-lysmaster er produceret af minimum ti lag glasfiber, hvilket giver masterne følgende fordele i forhold til de traditionelle lysmaster, som man ser i gadebilledet i dag. 

1. HOLDBARHED. Fiberlight-lysmaster har en holdbarhed på op til 60 år (mod de normale allerede eksisterende master, som har en levetid op 10 - 20 år).

2. STYRKE OG FLEKSIBILITET. Fiberlight-lysmaster er fleksible og modstandsdygtige i ekstreme vejrforhold. 

3. MILJØVENLIGHED. Fiberlight-lysmaster kan genanvendes i eksempelvis beton og er derved meget miljøvenlige. 

4. SIKKERHED. I tilfælde af en kollision/trafikuheld er de personlige og materiale skader væsentligt mindre, når kollisionen sker med Fiberlight-lysmaster, end når de sker med traditionelle produkter. 

5. NEMME AT INSTALLERE. Fiberlight-lysmaster vejer blot 35 kg, hvilket gør dem lette at montere, installere og udskifte. 

6. ÆSTETISKE. Fiberlight-lysmasters farvemæssige design kan tilpasses fuldstændig efter, hvad der ønskes. 

7. VEDLIGEHOLDELSESFRIE. Der er ingen vedligeholdelse ved Fiberlight-lysmaster.

Din Varmepumpemester er Jesper V. Jensen. Jesper har mange års erfaring med rådgivning og installation vedrørende energiløsninger, og ikke mindst opsætning af varmepumpeanlæg. 

Vi opsætter klimaanlæg i det meste af Danmark og store dele af det sydøstlige Sverige – vi kører dog hovedsagligt i områderne ved nord-, midt- og vest Sjælland.  

Varmepumpemesteren.dk leverer altid et solidt håndværk. Vælger du at investere i et nyt anlæg hos os, har du krav på en god oplevelse og en installation i topkvalitet, som holder i hele varmepumpens levetid. Derfor giver vi dig også mulighed for at få en servicekontrakt med til dit anlæg, så er du sikker på, at alt virker optimalt, når du skal bruge anlægget. Det kalder vi sund fornuft!

Ring eller skriv til os, hvis du har spørgsmål til dit varmeprojekt – vi kan ligeledes rådgive dig i forhold til at søge tilskud fra staten om energiforbedringer.

Name: GPV
Description:
GPV is one of Europe’s leading EMS (Electronics Manufacturing Services) companies. Our vision is to be our customers' most trusted, powerful, and top-of-mind EMS partner.

UV222TM is designed to emit far-UVC light at a particular wavelength of 222 nanometers. Previously, when a far-UVC lamp was designed to emit far-UVC light of 222 nanometers, the lamp would inevitably emit small amounts of secondary emission in other wavelengths as well. These wavelengths can be harmful. Our unique and patented safety filter technology blocks all the harmful and unwanted wavelengths from emission, which is a significant breakthrough for the disinfection of occupied spaces, highly increasing its effectiveness and usability against the spreading of infectious diseases, including COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2).

Ikke som de andre
I SIF Gruppen er vi ikke ligesom de andre. Vi tør være anderledes og skille os ud fra mængden. Vi lægger ikke skjul på at vi er mennesker og ikke blot et ukritisk og ufølsomt maskineri.

De Gæve SIF'ere
Vi kan måske endda betegne os lidt som romerrigets gæve Gallere. Vi er ikke de største og vi er ikke interesserede i at føre krig, men vi har troen på os selv og hinanden og vi står sammen som et stærkt team og værdsætter livsglæde og samarbejde.

Vores trylledrik
Gallerne havde naturligvis også lige en trylledrik til at hjælpe dem på vej. Det har vi ikke. Og dog alligevel. For trylledrikken er jo blot et middel der i forlængelse af sammenholdet bidrager til at opnå succes. Og vi har også et middel. Vores middel er vores vision, en vision vi alle brænder for og tror på kan lede os til stjernerne. Vi mener i SIF Gruppen at vejen til succes for både os og vores kunder er udvikling og handling i tæt samarbejde. Vi forstår at kunderne ikke er til for os, men at vi er til for hinanden og ved hjælp af gensidig respekt og forståelse finder vi de bedste løsninger. Vi er der når der er behov for det. Vi kan lytte og rådgive, projektere, installere og servicere inden for stort set alle former for el og VVS relateret arbejde.

En eventyrlig rejse
Historien om gallerne er selvfølgelig mest et eventyr, men SIF Gruppens historie er faktisk også et spændende eventyr. Eventyret starter helt tilbage i 1918, og de udfordringer vi er gennemgået, og de erfaringer vi har gjort os i de snart 100 år, har som i de fleste eventyr budt på både glæde og tårer, krig og kærlighed. Vi har oplevet familie forøgelser og generationsskifter, personlige og faglige udfordringer og alt dette har tilsammen gjort os til det vi er i dag. En stor og stærk sammentømret familie på omkring 200 medlemmer, med solide rødder og en god ballast hvad angår kompetencer og erfaring.

Description:

Description:
Originating from Denmark, ADDASOUND is a global leading provider of voice solutions and unified communication devices.

ADDASOUND’s products are designed and engineered in Denmark. The international team behind ADDASOUND has strong expertise in electro-acoustics and offers superior products with elegant Danish design.

The wide range of products caters to professionals in the contact center and office, speech recognition and unified communications. ADDASOUND always seeks to provide the customer with the best experience of voice communication and guarantees the highest standard of reliability and quality.

At CS electric, we have 50 years of experience with electrical services. We think sustainability and energy optimization into every solution we develop. This benefits society and not least our customers both economically, energy and environmentally.

Name: AVK Smart Water
Description:
Water is, without a doubt, the most important resource we have. That is why it is important to have efficient and safe water management. From reducing Non-Revenue Water and energy consumption to controlling your assets and extending your network’s lifetime. How do you ensure your water infrastructure is prepared for present and future standards?

AVK Smart Water, a part of the AVK Group, provides digital intelligent solutions for AVK core products, such as gate valves and hydrants. The IoT-based solutions provide a new intelligent way for utilities to monitor water infrastructure based on data instead of gut-feelings and assumptions.

AVK Smart Water solutions are powered by ASW-ATI, an Italian company with huge expertise in control systems for water and gas industry. ASW-ATI is proudly part of the AVK Group.

Name: BLOCK Transformatoren-Elektronik GmbH
Description:
BLOCK – perfecting power 

In our 80-year company history, BLOCK has expanded under CEO Wolfgang Reichelt to become one of the world's leading manufacturers of transformers, power supplies, electronic circuit breakers, reactors and EMI filters. With 1,200 employees, we are characterized above all by our global growth course - with 38 locations worldwide and four production sites in Germany, the USA and China.

Whether mechanical engineering, drive technology, railroad technology or regenerative energies – our products and solutions ensure the perfect voltage for systems and plants in all areas of business and industry. From the development center with more than 60 engineers and specialists to production, quality assurance and certification – all BLOCK products are developed and manufactured in-house and tested in our own EMC lab. 

Advanced research is especially important for us, because there is a keen transfer of knowledge at the intersection of basic and applied research. Through international cooperation with numerous colleges and universities, theoretical findings are transformed into practical knowledge – and thus become a real advantage in the competition for innovations.

Working at BLOCK 

Job security, a collaborative atmosphere and continuous employee training and development are our top priorities. Eleven apprenticeships, four dual courses of study, further training to become a technician, business administrator, master's degree or doctorate – we offer a wide variety of career paths depending on your skills and ideas. We also offer internships, support student research projects and term papers, and supervise final theses. 

For 80 years now, BLOCK has been shaping the economic landscape through progress with power. Thinking ahead for almost a century and continuing to develop innovative technologies for the future.

Name: A LED A/S
Description:
A LED A/S is a well-diversified manufacturer and distributor of high-quality, future-generation energy-efficient lighting products that are engineered for years of dependable performance. Our company focuses on innovation by providing efficient and cost-effective lighting solutions.

A LED A/S , was founded in 2009 and operates out of a 3500 square meter warehouse in Varde, Denmark. A LED A/S is dedicated to providing customers with the highest quality products for use in the Commercial, Institutional, and Industrial markets.

Name: Topsil GlobalWafers A/S
Description:
Topsil, founded 1959, is a world leading supplier of ultrapure silicon for the global semiconductor industry.

Topsil provides tailor-made silicon ingots and wafers, enabling customers to manufacture advanced and energy efficient power components. The components are used e.g. for energy transmission in wind turbines and the power grid, as frequency converters in motors and for electricity generation in high speed trains, in photo detectors for medical imaging and within quantum computing.

Customers include large semiconductor companies as well as research institutions worldwide. End products are applied in the transport, energy, detector, medico and numerous other industrial sectors.

Description:
SystemTeknik is a leading international supplier of electrical control technology systems and energy solutions.

The electrical control technology comprises solutions pertaining to electrical control and distribution switchboards, automation software (SCADA, PLC, SRO, HMI, etc.), on-site commissioning and an extensive service program. We have comprehensive experience from supplying to many different business sectors such as oil and gas, wind, marine, industry, OEMs, etc.

The energy department operate within two focal areas. One which focuses energy optimization in office as well as production areas. The other area pertains to off-grid energy solutions in remote areas with gained experience from diverse places such as Greenland and Uganda. 

SystemTeknik was founded in 1953 and has worked in the industry for electrical control technology since the beginning.

SystemTeknik certificates include: ISO 9001:2008 and 14001:2004, Achilles (ID number 26558), Basic  Offshore Safety Course incl. HUET, ATEX, KEMA KEUR, UL, and GOST.

SystemTeknik Headquarters is located in Denmark with SystemTeknik subsidiary Szczecin, Poland.

Name: Jansson El A/S

Name: Norlux
Description:
WHO WE ARE
Norlux specializes in developing lighting concepts and solutions in markets such as, Hotel & Interiors, Commercial & Retail and Office Environments. 

WE ARE THERE WHERE YOUR CUSTOMERS ARE
With offices, showrooms and distribution centers spread out over Northern Europe, we are there where your customers are. You can find us in Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark and the UK.

Our creative lighting concepts are customized to support and strengthen the client’s brand. We passionately believe that creative light solutions can and should, engage the customer in the physical space.

Name: Clayton Power
Description:
At Clayton Power, we develop scalable mobile power solutions that reduce emissions and improve the work environment. For 25 years, we’ve been driving the transition to more intelligent and efficient energy systems. Circularity is at the core of everything we do, and strong partnerships are essential to us. With tailored solutions, we help our customers move towards a smarter energy future – while also enabling optimization and supporting their ESG reporting with valuable energy data.

A track record of innovation, a culture of partnership
We develop solutions for some of the world’s leading companies. With a strong commitment to redefining industry standards, we develop everything in-house – from concept to final design – and we continuously work to improve our solutions. Being close to our operations makes us highly flexible and allows us to respond quickly to customer needs and the evolving global technology landscape.

We see our customers as partners. That’s why we often co-develop solutions with them – together, we set new standards for mobile energy solutions that truly make a difference.

European presence & production
Headquartered in Denmark and operating in 20+ countries across Europe, we’re proud of our European-based production setup. It enables us to deliver efficient, scalable, and high-quality solutions with a strong focus on testing and service.
Come visit us at our Innovation Center in Odense, where we showcase the mobile power systems helping to create a more sustainable tomorrow – today.

Name: Danfoss IXA
Description:
At Danfoss IXA, we lead innovation in exhaust gas emission monitoring for the maritime industry, setting new standards in environmental sustainability and performance optimization. 

Our mission is to provide cutting-edge solutions that help our clients comply with stringent environmental regulations while optimizing their operational efficiency.

Our Solutions
We specialize in:
•	Scrubber Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring vessels meet MARPOL and IMO standards through precise monitoring and reporting.
•	SCR/EGR Process Control: Optimizing systems for IMO Tier III and EPA Tier IV compliance, enhancing performance and reducing emissions.

Our advanced, patented technology provides precise, continuous measurements of NOx, NH3, SO2, and CO2, even in the harshest maritime environments. These solutions are essential for meeting environmental regulations and optimizing various on-board systems, ensuring both regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.

Who We Are
Founded in April 2009, Danfoss IXA is a dynamic part of the Danfoss Group, leveraging the global reach and strength of over 40,000 employees. We are a team of highly skilled specialists devoted to the innovation, distribution, maintenance, and implementation of marine emission monitoring systems.

Website
For more information, visit our website: https://danfoss-ixa.com/

Join us in leading the industry towards sustainability and environmental stewardship.

Name: LED iBond
Description:
At LED iBond, we invent new lighting solutions. 

The main focus areas are LED lighting solutions for parking facilities, LED grow light solutions for greenhouses and customized lighting solutions.

As an innovative lighting manufacturer, we inspire new concepts by new ways of utilizing LED technology. We make a difference by offering new tools for designers and architects. New tools that are not just more of the same, but a truly unique representation of state-of-the-art technology. 

We engineer, design and manufacture sustainable lighting elements in Denmark that are reliable, adaptable and highly efficient, as well as offering new and exciting possibilities for shape and form. 


Protected by a comprehensive list of patents, the technology platform presents a unique value proposition combining total design flexibility and low total costs of ownership.

Innovative lighting solutions - made in Denmark.

Name: EPTechnologies
Description:
EPTechnologies is a complete marine propulsion provider for electric and hybrid vessels. We guide the customers through the process of turning dreams into real hybrid and electric vessels with the use of the finest quality that makes economical sense.

With us you get all out of one hand, from our in-house lithium-ion batteries, DC-generators and sail /shaft or Z / Jet drives and it’s  all controlled by our own truster control and EMS / PMS software systems. 

As long-time sailors and boat owners we are aware of the problems that can occur on a daily basis.  Therefore, we create systems designed with backup options and constructing them to be as simple as possible. For big systems with parallel strings we have double communication lines and double system controllers with back up functions.

If there is something we can’t do in-house, we use our extensive network and highly competent partners to find the right solutions.

We design and manufacture Lithium NCM and LFP batteries 24-800 VDC. EPT lithium batteries are available in two technologies, 12 VDC in LiFePO4 and 24&48 VDC in NMC, with a nominal capacity from 52 to 150 Ah (2-2.8 kWh). All batteries comes in the same size. Right now, we believe we have the lightest and safest batteries used in the marine industry. We are working on a life-cycle strategy for the lithium batteries as recycling is a part of our future strategy. 

To be able to control the vessels remotely we acquired the App BoatControl. This App is easy to install, adaptable to the individual vessel and is intuitive to operate.  

EPTechnologies also manufacture electric outboard motors with a range from 50HP to 400HP. They are easy to operate, exceptional performance and with high security standards. We also put emphasis on making it a good-looker.

Our years of experience, quality, innovation and durability is a guarantee for a stress-free drive / sailing experience. We stand by our service!

Name: TS TECH A/S
Description:
TS TECH is a reliable and flexible supplier of electrical installation, components, equipment and services in a broad range of industries such as wind, marine, energy, communication and related industries. We are experts in mobilisation, shipments, industrial, installations and more.
 
Our Service may contain technicians or project solutions that include engineering/design, materials delivery, installation, testing and commissioning. We deliver our projects in close cooperation with our customers, focusing on high-quality solutions and maximum flexibility at competitive prices.
 
To learn more about our services, visit www.tstech.dk
 
Our experienced technicians have broad knowledge and are experienced in integrated solutions whether the projects are related to new buildings, renovations or conversions.
 
Moreover, TS TECH performs inspection of existing systems and installations. All inspections are followed by a documented report specifying the current status and our recommendations on actions surrounding potential repair, replacement of components, improvements and upgrades of systems.
 
We are based in Esbjerg – The Energy Metropol of Denmark.

Name: MOCON Europe A/S
Description:
Are you seeking knowledge about quality control of food, pharmaceutical or medical device product packaging?  Are you interested in QA and QC of Modified Atmosphere Packaging (MAP)? Then you have come to the right place! We hope you will enjoy our content and please don’t forget to follow us here on LinkedIn.

MOCON Europe A/S (Dansensor) has specialized in testing packaging integrity since 1983 and we are a world leader in MAP quality control. 
We engineer quality control and assurance solutions for the food and healthcare sectors – particularly for products packed in a protective gas atmosphere. Modified Atmosphere Packaging is a natural way to preserve products, significantly increasing their shelf life while maintaining their flavour, appearance and aroma. 

Headquartered in Denmark, MOCON Europe A/S (Dansensor) has offices and partners in many countries worldwide. MOCON Europe A/S is owned by AMETEK, USA.

Name: Brodersen A/S
Description:
Brodersen designs and manufactures all-in-one automation controllers and communication devices with unsurpassed platform adaptability. The company is based on four decades of industrial automation development. We serve partners and customers from both the public and private sectors, including system integrators, engineering companies, OEMs and application end users.

The very robust design of our products is specifically developed for outstations in harsh environments. Our track record speaks for itself. The quality of our products is reflected in a distinct durability in the field.

Our experience is obtained through in-depth collaboration and support in solution design for some of the most demanding and successful companies in the world.

Brodersen has deep roots in Scandinavia, the region of which is known for dynamic utility distribution, complex infrastructure and high expectations to quality standards.

Owing to product capabilities, flexibility and the niche application knowhow of our specialists, Brodersen Systems is able to offer customers more simplified systems. In this way we reduce total project lifecycle costs to the benefit of both integrators and end users.

SELCO is a leading manufacturer of protection relays, alarm monitoring and engine & generator control products that are used in marine, offshore and industrial applications. SELCO is headquartered in Roskilde, Denmark.

Since its founding in 1984, SELCO has been a pioneer and leader in the development of extremely reliable electrical products for harsh industries like marine and offshore, and has earned a reputation for high quality and value. Name: Scankab Cables
Description:
THE CABLE INDUSTRY’S ANSWER TO ”GARAGE ROCK”
From the outset in 1992, Scankab was the rebel of the cable industry. The business sold cables from a small garage store room and challenged the cable market.   
Most recently, Scankab has made its mark as a front runner in fireproof cables (CPR).

Full-line supplier
Scankab develops, manufactures and supplies quality cables and routing to electrical contractors, industry, marine & offshore, infrastructure and energy. Since 2004, the company, which is based in the western part of Fuen, has been bestowed the honourable title of gazelle by the Danish Børsen. Scankab employs 42 staff at its headquarters in Aarup and its subsidiaries in Norway and Sweden. In 2015, Scankab extended its cable business by adding routing. The combination of more than 3,500 types of cable held in stock, the widest range of routing and an out-and-out flair for customer service, makes Scankab an attractive full-line supplier of cables.

The cable supplier of tomorrow
Technology and society have both changed dramatically over the 25-year lifespan of Scankab. However, one thing has not changed. The world needs cables.

"The more wireless connections we have, the greater the need for power units, and they require cables," 
says Morten Rasmussen, CEO.
As a supplier of tomorrows cable solutions, Scankab continues to focus on the development and competitive edge of the business.

Her kom idéen til et skibspatent fra hjertet, ved at tænke utraditionelt og betragte en skibsmotor som en levende organisme, idet hjælpeaggregaterne ikke behøver at arbejde så hårdt, når skibet tøffer roligt af sted i rum sø.

Grundideen var den samme som i det menneskelige hjerte. Når man arbejder hårdt, banker hjertet for fuldt drøn. Når man er i hvile, slår hjertet langsom. I denne analogi svarere hjertet til hjælpeaggregaterne i et skib, som leverer energi til skibets pumper og elektriske installation så som lys, asynkronmotorer, radar, transformatorer mv.

Dette idegrundlag udmøntede sig for fournais i et patent i hele den europæiske patentunion, plus 10 lande uden for unionen.

Derfor var det naturligt at virksomheden i starten af 1980'erne kom til at repræsentere en tysk generatorproducent, der på daværende tidspunkt specielt egnede sig til dette formål. Firmaet fournais kunne således bl.a. få fremstillet individuelle "tailor made" roterende elektriske maskiner efter egen dimensionering- og udlægning, dvs. efter eget design- og patent.

Name: Techno-Matic A/S
Description:
Techno-Matic is a Danish electronics company specialised in embedded solutions. In collaboration with our customers, we develop solutions regarding control, surveillance and inspection of machines that are either operated by hydraulic or by electric motors.

As a customer at Techno-Matic, you can choose whether you want your solution delivered on print or if you want a more complete solution in a box with or without cord set. To make sure every customer leave with the proper solution, we will either create your solution based on some of our standard modules or develop new modules for your specific solution.

We have developed solutions for a variety of different machines, where some of them have been produced in only one copy and others we produce several thousand a year. No matter how you prefer to get your solution delivered, the focus area in the development of our solutions is always to develop solutions that match your machines and that meet your wishes.

We are actively involved in everything from idea generation to the final test of your new machine. Our involvement is not limited to software and hardware, we also make proactive dialogues in relation to the machine's equipment.

In relation to hardware, it will be possible to perform current measurements, so the steering of hydraulic valves will be even more precise independent of temperatures. Our new series of hardware supports your need for communication, data transmissions and updates of software via the internet.

In our latest customer projects, we have been focusing on the possibilities within Big-Data and Internet of Things (IoT). IoT describes the communication between electronic devices with the purpose of creating more available data, which creates new possibilities for improvements within the field of service solutions.


You are more than welcome to contact us if you need a competent partner to help you with surveillance, control or inspection of your hydraulic or electric operated machines.
